source_review: Native callback retains its two-argument contract; full Visual24, Mesh88 and four-vertex typed polygon interfaces are compatible.

Original local evidence authenticates x/y/z-before-vscale/voffset ordering. The meaningful len=19 border local is a disclosed accepted-reconstruction local absent from original DWARF, not unused storage.
Genuine HidePoly has a disclosed pre-entry deleted-helper stub, outside the root extent and not claimed. No extra trailing root words.
All 48 quad bytes, including zero coordinates and trailing bytes, are checked separately; native palette, alpha and white bytes are also bound.
Default palette uses actual entry4 of the five-entry table. Native world flags0x3600 and callback differences are retained over later GC spelling.
No array-bound violation found within the stated valid player/view/palette indices and four-vertex domain.

The seven transitive callees are individually strict, full-extent and explicitly claimed in the closure recipes; no unmatched callable boundary remains. Polygon register jump is its internal switch dispatch, not an omitted indirect call.
proof_limits: Host field/geometry testing is not native execution and does not prove general floating-point equivalence.
Atan is injected and polygon is an argument-capture boundary. Identity matrices, fixed positive view angles and defense.flags=1 limit the exercised geometry/alpha domain.
Invalid indices, arbitrary camera inputs, concurrency, full-game runtime and canonical integration remain outside this proof.
